chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
No person is to be blamed for delay in (securing) his own right but blame lies on him who takes what he is not entitled to.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between delaying a right and taking what is not yours according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) distinguishes between the passive right of ownership and the active injustice of usurpation, reflecting the Shia jurisprudential principle that delay in claiming one's due does not constitute forfeiture. This teaching underscores the virtue of dignified patience (hilm) over the vice of aggressive appropriation (ghubn), emphasizing that moral blame attaches to the unjust taker rather than the patient claimant. It serves as a practical guide for social conduct, encouraging believers to assert their rights without becoming oppressors themselves.
